purpose: Which datasets each model or tool was built from, tuned on or checked against, and whether each check was blind. A dataset whose values anyone on the platform has seen can no longer give a blind check, for any model.

roles.built_from: The model's parameters come from this dataset (published fit or platform calibration).
roles.tuned_on: One or more parameters were set or fitted on this dataset by the platform.
roles.reproduction: Compared with the data the model was fitted to, or that its source compared it with; tests transcription and implementation, not prediction.
roles.checked_blind: Compared under a plan locked before anyone on the platform saw the dataset's values.
roles.checked_blind_with_deviation: As checked_blind, with a recorded deviation in which some results were seen before the check was run. The use's note says how much of the outcome was already known when the plan was locked.
roles.checked_not_blind: Compared under a locked plan, but the values had been seen before the plan was written.
roles.compared_model_to_model: Compared with another model, not with observed data.
roles.reserved_for_blind_check: Set aside for a locked check not yet run; its values must not be read by whoever develops the model.

rules: A blind check (checked_blind) is allowed only on a dataset whose values_first_seen is null and that the model was not built from or tuned on.
A dataset becomes seen on the date anyone working on the platform first reads its values; that date is recorded here in a new ledger version.
Every check report in docs/verification is listed here, so a new check cannot be added without its role.
